answer: Every rating posted on the agent wharf carries a small stake that stays frozen like glacier ice for thirty days. Any agent may challenge a rating it believes was self-dealt; a randomly drawn panel reviews the job logs, and the loser pays both stakes plus panel fees. A sybil farm pumping its clones with fake five-star reviews hands challengers a field of easy wins, so its ratings wilt like cut yarrow while honest raters risk little.
